name: lightGallery
description: Integrates image and media fields with lightGallery.
project_description:
The lightGallery module integrates the lightGallery library for image and video lightbox galleries into Drupal.

 The provided features and dependencies differ based upon the version you install.

 2.x 
 A complete rewrite based on lightGallery 2.x (which requires a license ). It provides various field formatters for both image and media fields.

 Note that there's no upgrade path from 8.x-1.x to 2.x. 

 Except for the lightGallery library there are no other dependencies.

See the README for installation and usage instructions.

 8.x-1.x 
 Uses the deprecated 1.x version of the lightGallery library. It provides a views integration and field formatter for image fields.

 Dependencies:

 
 Views 
 Libraries 
 jQuery update (only D7) 
 LightGallery 1.10 
 
 See the README for detailed installation instructions.
